summary: Mexico's 2025 GDP was $1,832,641,364,775.52 USD and GDP per capita was $13,889.234 USD, with inflation at 3.8067% in 2025. As of 2026-05-01, the 10-year bond yield was 9.45%, and as of 2026-09-12, the MXN/USD exchange rate was 0.058948 USD per MXN, with an FX change of 0.123 (unit unspecified). Historical data covers GDP, GDP per capita, and inflation from 2016 to 2025, bond yields from 2016 to 2026, and exchange rates from 2020 to 2026, but 2026 GDP and per-capita figures are unavailable.
